issue.title: Prompt g-prefix which-key hint panel silently drops its last row when the prompt bar hits its height cap
issue.description:
DISCOVERED while landing epic sase-p1 (glossary panel). Surfaced by that epic but the
truncation mechanism is pre-existing and independent of it: sase-p1.7 added one hint row
(`gG  glossary...`) to the prompt `g` prefix table, and in a constrained layout that one
extra row pushed the last existing row off the bottom with no indicator.

EVIDENCE (visible in a checked-in golden):
  tests/ace/tui/visual/snapshots/png/prompt_stack_g_prefix_hints_120x40.png
At 120x40 with a two-pane prompt stack, the panel previously rendered 11 rows ending in
`gx  save as xprompt`. After `gG  glossary...` was inserted alphabetically, the panel
still renders 11 rows and `gx  save as xprompt` is simply gone from the frame. The key
still works; it is just no longer discoverable from the which-key panel that exists to
advertise it.

MECHANISM: src/sase/ace/tui/widgets/_prompt_input_bar_g_prefix_hints.py builds the full
entry list and sets `_g_prefix_hints_line_count = len(lines) + 3`; that count is fed to
`_update_height` in _prompt_input_bar_stack_lifecycle.py:146-181, which clamps the whole
bar to `screen_height - 2`. When the clamp binds, the panel is cropped from the bottom
with no scroll affordance, no `+N more`, and no reordering -- so the loss is silent and
always hits the alphabetically-last entries.

SCOPE: decide and implement the overflow behavior for this panel -- e.g. paginate or
scroll, render a `+N more` footer, or flow into columns when rows exceed the budget --
and cover it with a test at a height where the clamp binds. Adding rows to the `g` table
is routine, so the next addition silently hides `gt` next.

REPRODUCTION: just test-visual tests/ace/tui/visual/test_ace_png_snapshots_prompt_stack.py::test_prompt_stack_g_prefix_hints_png_snapshot
then compare the recorded golden against the pre-sase-p1.7 revision of the same file.

payload.entry: RELATED: sase-of — 'Procs pane hints line overflows its width' is the same class of defect (an ACE hints surface that clips without telling the user) on a different pane. Whatever affordance sase-of settles on for width overflow is probably the right vocabulary for this height overflow.

PROPOSED BY: epic sase-p1 (glossary panel) land agent. Phase sase-p1.7 added the gG row; the golden was re-recorded during sase-p1's landing (commit on master), so the checked-in PNG already shows the truncated state.

payload.close_reason: Fixed by 671d27c89 'fix(ace): stabilize responsive pane layout', same overflow-affordance change as the Procs hints line: compact layouts now show that shortcuts were omitted instead of silently dropping the last row. The commit regenerated prompt_stack_g_prefix_hints_120x40.png and extended tests/ace/tui/widgets/test_prompt_g_prefix_hint_lifecycle.py. Verified 2026-08-24 at 45806495f.
